EmailTemplate.description: Sent to High Priority verified applicants to choose between Home Visit and No Visit (Kids Only).
EmailTemplate.name: Christmas Program - Home Visit Option (Exhibit 1)
EmailTemplate.subject: Help Give Hope Christmas Program – Important Household Visit Option {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Christmas Applicant,
Thank you for applying for Christmas assistance through Help Give Hope.
As we prepare for this year’s Christmas program, we are giving families the option of requesting a brief in-home visit to discuss essential household needs.
Option 1: Christmas Gifts Only (No Visit Needed) To select No Visit, click this link: https://helpgivehope.my.salesforce-sites.com/public?action=choice&choice=kids_only&id={!Case.Id}
Option 2: Christmas Gifts + Household Needs Visit To request a Home Visit, click this link: https://helpgivehope.my.salesforce-sites.com/public?action=choice&choice=home_visit&id={!Case.Id}
Thank you for helping us make the best use of our volunteers and resources so we can serve as many families as possible this Christmas.
Warm regards, Help Give Hope Team
